subject: Trading
title: Hedging a Portfolio
description: A micro-lesson that makes Hedging a Portfolio usable.

hook.text: You're bullish long-term but worried about the next three months. Buying SPX puts hedges your portfolio without selling.

buildup.text: Index puts protect broad portfolios. A $500 put on SPX can insure hundreds of thousands in equity exposure.

discovery.text: The cost of hedging is typically 1-3% of portfolio value per year—similar to insurance premiums on a house.

twist.text: Continuous hedging is expensive and drags returns if markets keep rising. Most investors hedge tactically, not always.

climax.text: In 2020, investors with portfolio hedges in place were calm during the crash—and had cash to buy the dip.

punchline.text: Hedges cost during good times. They save you during bad.

quiz.question: How can index puts hedge a portfolio?
options: They offset losses in a broad portfolio when the market falls
